children: Non-Invasive Monitoring Systems entered into Amendment No. 4 to its merger agreement with Gravitics. The change updates the definition of "Public Offering" to an underwritten offering currently expected at $50 million, but not less than $40 million, excluding any over-allotment. All other merger terms remain unchanged. The amendment is intended to clarify financing parameters to support the pending combination.
: Amendment No. 4 to Agreement and Plan of Merger and Reorganization
: Clarify offering size to advance merger closing
